competing_explanation: A gain can arise from encoder capacity, seed or fold instability, dense unsafe activation, spatial action priors, or overfitting rather than decision alignment; the matched separate-head arm, frozen-feature ablation, shuffled replay, scene-level OOF design, tail metrics, and subgroup diagnostics address these alternatives. Conversely, a flat 75-to-100 percent curve with failed absolute utility despite favorable oracle feasibility supports structural observability or action-family limitation, while a positive paired slope supports but does not prove data limitation.
controls: GitHub-main parent terminal, summary, raw inventory, train split, action oracle, official anchor, checkpoint, and runtime identities
full SHA-256 recomputation of all 750 parent scene caches and 400 parent test-development variant caches before training
nested group-respecting 120/240/360/480 subsets with five outer folds and three deterministic paired seeds
parameter-matched separate utility/risk-head arm at every train size
explicit keep action and deterministic within-scene shuffled-action replay
selected-area harm, image-level PSNR, RGB SSIM, RGB color-bias, CVaR, severe-harm, action-distribution, subgroup-tail, seed, and fold diagnostics
cloud-only checkpoints, raw unit predictions, unit receipts, and SHA inventory
disabled_actions: changing the official ConvIR-B architecture, checkpoint, action scales, renderer, utility threshold, harm threshold, activation floors, or precision target
using hard oracle-argmax labels as the primary target
using a separate risk-veto head as the candidate controller
using synthetic haze parameters, filenames, or GT-derived deployment inputs
reading candidate-confirmation, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, ITS, or OTS data
treating tiles, actions, variants, folds, seeds, checkpoints, or bootstrap draws as independent samples
allowing a favorable learning-curve slope to override a failed absolute utility, activation, safety, or precision gate

gates.reference: Exact GitHub parent, raw cache, dataset role, official source, checkpoint, runtime, and entrypoint identities
Complete 135-model arm by train-size by fold by seed grid, nested subsets, 600-scene OOF ensembles, and 137-unit ledger
Pre-training 150-scene effective-positive count and oracle selective coverage with bounded selected harm
Joint 480-scene-arm 600-scene OOF PSNR-gain simultaneous lower bound against keep
Joint 480-scene-arm action-area lower bound and active-scene Wilson lower bound
Selected-area harm ratio and image-level PSNR, RGB SSIM, and color-bias harm upper bounds
Joint full-data OOF gain simultaneous half-width
Paired 75-percent to 100-percent joint-controller OOF gain slope

fixed_factors: the official ConvIR-B base architecture, Haze4K checkpoint, renderer, keep output, and action residual scales 0.8 and 1.2 remain frozen
the deployment input contains only observable ConvIR output, internal feature, shape, multiscale context, and deterministic flip/scale disagreement tensors
GT-derived utility and harm are supervision and evaluation targets only and never enter the controller input
joint targets are soft risk-adjusted action distributions rather than hard oracle-argmax labels
keep is an explicit no-op and rejection action in the same three-way policy
the separate-head arm shares the encoder and optimization budget and differs by less than one percent in parameters
the frozen-feature arm runs only at 480 training scenes and isolates learned-encoder value
each outer fold contains 120 OOF scenes and nested deterministic 120/240/360/480 scene subsets from its disjoint 480-scene training partition
five folds, three paired seeds, tiles, actions, haze variants, and bootstrap draws never increase independent n
the 150-scene target-feasibility role and 100-scene four-variant stability role never enter model fitting or the primary OOF estimand
gain 0.05 dB, harm boundary -0.10 dB, harm UCB 0.10, active-scene floor 0.20, action-area floor 0.01, and precision 0.025 dB remain frozen
candidate-confirmation, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, ITS, and OTS remain unread
intervention.matched_budget: five fixed scene folds, three paired seeds, 24 fixed epochs, nested 120/240/360/480 training scenes per 480-scene outer-training partition, 600 OOF scenes, 150 disjoint target-feasibility scenes, and 100 four-variant target-stability scenes
intervention.primary_variable: joint observable encoder plus soft direct keep/weaken/strengthen decision objective
intervention.reference: parameter-matched separate utility/risk heads, a full-data base-feature direct-policy ablation, keep, deterministic within-scene shuffle, and GT-privileged target-feasibility and oracle controls

primary_estimand.aggregation: five-fold OOF mean over 600 original-clear scenes with fold-stratified paired bootstrap

question: Can a jointly trained observable encoder and direct three-action policy recover material Haze4K OOF gain with nondegenerate activation and bounded tail harm, and does the nested learning curve support data limitation rather than structural saturation?
